title: Counter-Selector Wave 11: Batch 04 parallel official-record acquisition
purpose: Acquire the fourth class-balanced denominator batch while preserving individual, collective, control, correction, and disputed-system evidence as distinct units of analysis.

records.public_label: Doors-off helicopter pilot hazard warnings and deficient safety management
records.artifact_summary: Official NTSB records preserve repeated operational warnings about tether entanglement, emergency egress, cutting tools, and flotation, management nonresponse, and a later accident in which those hazards contributed to five deaths.
missing_receipts: original pilot warning emails or reports
individual authorship and recipient acknowledgment
complete response chain for each warning
support and authority ledger
independent handoff or cross-domain transfer evidence
records.falsifier: Contemporaneous records showing that the warnings were not made before the accident, did not concern the later contributing hazards, or received technically adequate corrective action would defeat or narrow advancement.

records.public_label: Merits-based retraction after a final research-misconduct finding
records.artifact_summary: The federal record preserves a final misconduct finding and linked publication retractions, providing a control against treating every publication gate or retraction as suppression of a misunderstood outsider.
missing_receipts: original complainant allegation and complete institutional file
full appeal or settlement record if any
evidence sufficient to generalize beyond this case
records.falsifier: A reversal of the final misconduct finding or evidence that the cited retractions were unrelated to the adjudicated conduct would defeat the control.

records.public_label: Tank-car safety recommendation persistence without completed event inference
records.artifact_summary: Official NTSB records preserve a decades-long recommendation stream concerning DOT-111 vulnerability, repeated event receipts, partial regulatory implementation, and renewed phase-out recommendations.
missing_receipts: one bounded specialist-authored work object tied to one decision gate
complete regulator response chronology for each recommendation
person-level authorship support and handoff evidence
records.falsifier: A record showing that the recommendation stream was fully implemented before the cited events or that the cited events did not involve the identified vulnerability would narrow the mechanism finding.

records.public_label: Special prosecutor removal order and attorney-general refusal
records.artifact_summary: Federal records preserve preexisting commitments to special-prosecutor independence, a direct order to discharge the prosecutor, a written refusal and resignation, a second refusal, and eventual execution by the next official.
missing_receipts: complete legal analysis underlying the refusal
support and authority ledger normalized against the office
independent handoff receipt preserving the object after resignation
cross-domain transfer artifact
evidence of model update after contradiction rather than principled refusal alone
records.falsifier: A contemporaneous record showing no prior commitment, no direct refusal, or an independently sufficient ordinary reason for resignation unrelated to the discharge order would defeat advancement.

records.public_label: Institutional reversal of a carelessness finding
records.artifact_summary: The institution formally reversed an earlier carelessness finding after external expert review, reassigned the error to a systemic process, and cleared the researcher of the prior suspicion.
missing_receipts: pre-decision and post-decision employment and funding state
complete collaboration and custody state
evidence of timely voluntary repair before external review
durable handoff or relationship repair
records.falsifier: A later authoritative record reinstating the carelessness finding or showing that no formal record was corrected would defeat the mechanism finding.

records.public_label: Editorial endorsement veto and disputed assignment of silence
records.artifact_summary: Public reporting preserves a disputed authorship-transfer surface—owner-assigned silence versus editor-described veto—and resulting resignations, but not the complete internal record or independent adjudication.
missing_receipts: proposed endorsement and revision history
complete owner-editor communications
formal governance and decision authority record
independent adjudication of competing accounts
durable post-dispute custody and relationship state
records.falsifier: Complete records showing that no endorsement was proposed or that the board independently chose silence without owner intervention would defeat the veto account.

blind_packets.task: Identify and communicate foreseeable hazards in a novel passenger-flight configuration before an irreversible operation.
requirements: route warnings to an accountable management surface
preserve the warning and response record
seek corrective action proportionate to public risk
bounded_chronology: operational personnel identified tether, control-entanglement, egress, cutting-tool, and flotation hazards
warnings were repeatedly raised
management did not resolve the hazards
the operation continued
the identified hazards contributed to a fatal accident
blind_packets.observable_transition: Multiple operational warnings failed to become effective corrective custody before a fatal operation.
counterevidence: the packet does not preserve each original warning object
individual authorship and recipient acknowledgment are absent
later catastrophe does not prove every warning was technically complete
blind_packets.falsifier: A contemporaneous record showing no pre-accident warnings or timely adequate correction would defeat advancement.

blind_packets.task: Adjudicate alleged research misconduct and correct the publication record only after a defined merits process.
bounded_chronology: research conduct was investigated
a federal merits finding identified falsification fabrication and plagiarism
identified papers were retracted
the record remains source-addressable
blind_packets.observable_transition: A publication gate followed a merits finding rather than an unreviewed disagreement.
counterevidence: the original complaint and complete institutional file are absent
one case does not establish universal fairness
the packet is a system control, not a person finding
blind_packets.falsifier: Reversal of the finding or disconnection between the finding and the retractions would defeat the control.

blind_packets.task: Maintain a safety recommendation across repeated events and changing regulatory states without converting persistence into proof of one decisionmaker's motive.
requirements: link later events to the bounded vulnerability
retain limits on causal and person attribution
bounded_chronology: tank-car vulnerability was identified
replacement or retrofit recommendations were issued
implementation was partial and commodity-limited
later derailments again produced hazardous-material releases
phase-out recommendations were reiterated
blind_packets.observable_transition: A long-lived safety recommendation persisted across incomplete implementation and repeated events.
counterevidence: the packet is institutional rather than person-level
different delays may have different causes
not every later breach establishes the same decision chain
blind_packets.falsifier: Full implementation before the cited events or absence of the identified vulnerability would narrow the finding.

blind_packets.task: Preserve precommitted legal independence when a superior directs removal of an independent checking function.
requirements: identify the governing commitment and authority boundary
state the conflict in a reviewable form
preserve institutional continuity and custody through departure
bounded_chronology: public confirmation commitments established checking-function independence
the checking function pursued contested evidence
a superior ordered its discharge
the responsible legal officer refused and resigned with written reasons
a second official refused
the next official executed the order
blind_packets.observable_transition: A direct directive was refused under preexisting commitments, but the officeholder exited and the directive was executed by a successor.
counterevidence: the role carried exceptional status authority and support
the packet does not resolve every legal argument
resignation may preserve personal integrity while surrendering the decision gate
cross-domain transfer and later model update are absent
blind_packets.falsifier: No prior commitment, no direct refusal, or an unrelated ordinary resignation record would defeat advancement.

blind_packets.task: Reopen and correct a damaging formal classification after independent expert review.
requirements: identify what standing was restored and what remains unresolved
bounded_chronology: an individual was formally found careless
leadership changed
the matter was referred to an external expert panel
the panel attributed the issue to a systemic fault
the institution reversed the finding and cleared the suspicion
blind_packets.observable_transition: A damaging individual classification was replaced by a systemic explanation through formal reconsideration.
counterevidence: full employment funding reputation and collaboration restoration are not shown
external review is not internal elasticity
no durable partnership receipt is present
blind_packets.falsifier: A later authoritative reinstatement of the original finding or absence of formal correction would defeat the mechanism.
